caption: A laser pointer's red dot moves across a projected slide as the pointer is moved.

sa.check: A laser pointer's dot is on a projected slide.
The dot moves across the slide.
The pointer moves first and the dot moves with it.

pc.expect: The dot moves with the pointer and appears only while the button is pressed.
pc.fail: The dot stays put while the pointer moves; or it remains after release; or it appears with no pointer.

pc.expect: The dot does not move on its own or linger.
pc.fail: It drifts with the pointer still; or leaves a trail; or jumps.

pc.expect: The dot is one small red spot.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a large patch; or changes shape.

pc.expect: The dot is red on every part of the slide.
pc.fail: It changes colour; or is white; or the slide changes with no click.
A second dot appears; or the pointer vanishes; or the dot becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The slide and the screen stay the same.
pc.fail: The slide changes with no click; or the screen changes; or the room changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
